title: Circuit gate equations hold on the witness
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, let $w$ be a Boolean input, and let $i$ be a gate index. The homogeneous quadratic equation encoding gate $i$ is satisfied by the quadratic witness obtained from $w$ and the evaluations of the circuit’s gates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits
A gate index of the circuit
